title: Resource failure trend (hourly)
sqlTemplate: select histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') as bucket, count(*) filter (where resource_status_code >= 400 or resource_status_code = 0) as failed_resources, count(*) as resources from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'resource' group by bucket order by bucket asc limit 200
emptyDataSemantics: No matching resource records in the window -> an empty result set (zero rows/buckets), not a zero-valued row.
